rationale: The update replaces the failed literal co-occurrence gate with three complete-source semantic inspections for operative disclosure structure, disposal triggers, and post-disposal retention. Their grounded evidence is then decomposed into the existing typed vocabulary. This captures inherited list permissions, protected information described as “information it receives,” and permissions whose confidentiality condition appears in a separate unit. It also distinguishes vague outsider prohibitions from literal third-party prohibitions. Disposal repair is source-local: valid upstream obligations are preserved, missing endpoint clauses are added, and only the demonstrated misuse of purpose_completion for a business-relationship endpoint is replaced by a truthful new trigger type. Unknown or inadequately grounded readings remain unresolved; source-wide negative choices create no implicit negative norm.
